items.heading: Musakhan
details: Key ingredients: chicken, sumac, onion, flatbread, pine nuts
Saute a large amount of onion with sumac until deeply softened.
Roast or pan-sear chicken pieces until cooked through.
Layer flatbread with the sumac onions and chicken.
Bake briefly and top with toasted pine nuts before serving.

items.heading: Maqluba Palestinian
details: Key ingredients: rice, eggplant, chicken, cauliflower
Fry slices of eggplant and cauliflower until golden.
Layer the vegetables with chicken and rice in a pot.
Add spiced broth and simmer until the rice is fully cooked.
Invert the pot onto a platter to reveal the layered dish.
